title: Analyze public records
condition: Crossover received 7,183 Animal Services field-call case records on November 2. In raw form, administrative records don't by themselves tell us what happens to dogs needing help—they are cases, not a census of individual dogs. Cleaning, interpreting, and analyzing them (and reconciling public shelter data) is underway to remove that barrier to understanding reality. No published findings are claimed yet.

actionDetails.whatNeeded: Produce source-grounded, useful findings about reported needs and service responses.
actionDetails.howToHelp: Review field-call records and reconcile public shelter statistics; publish findings with limitations.
